KuCoin Earn is a one-stop wealth management service platform created by KuCoin. Users can use various financial products to increase the value of their holdings.
KuCoin Earn offers two main Earn product categories: Stable and Advanced.
Stable products include Simple Earn (Flexible/Fixed) and Staking, made to be low-risk and easy to use. Flexible products allow redemption at any time, while fixed products are automatically redeemed at maturity and typically offer higher returns.
Advanced products are mainly structured investments, such as Dual Investment, Shark Fin, and Snowball. These have fixed-terms and settle automatically at maturity, suitable for users with investment experience seeking higher potential returns.
Select the arrow next to a coin on KuCoin Earn to view all available products. Subscribe and enter the amount you wish to invest.
Select a product type in your Earn Account to view all of the corresponding products you have purchased.
Balanced Products: Flexible-term products can be redeemed anytime in your Earn Account. For fixed term products, the funds will be automatically redeemed at maturity and transferred to your Funding Account.
Advanced Products: Products will be automatically settled upon maturity. The funds will be transferred to your Funding Account.
Interest rates adjust in response to market conditions and movements within the crypto market.

Venue: Gate
Headline: Perp Comeback Rewards: Return to Trading and Earn Up to 86 USDT

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Welcome back, traders. The Gate Web3 Perp Comeback Rewards campaign is officially underway, bringing exclusive, limited-time rewards to returning perpetual futures traders. During the event, eligible returning users can trade perpetual futures on Gate Perp DEX to unlock exclusive comeback rewards, trading milestone rewards, and multi-day trading rewards.
Share a total prize pool of 5,000 USDT, with up to 86 USDT in rewards per user. Rewards are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 27, 2026, 09:00 – December 11, 2026, 09:00 (UTC)
## How to Participate
Visit the event page, connect your wallet, and register for the event.
Eligible returning users can visit Gate Perp DEX and trade any perpetual futures trading pair.
Complete the designated trading tasks for a chance to earn corresponding rewards.
## Event 1: Exclusive Comeback Rewards – Share 1,500 USDT
Welcome back with exclusive reward. Users who previously traded perpetual futures on Gate Perp DEX but have not traded for at least 7 consecutive days before the event starts can earn exclusive comeback rewards by reaching the corresponding cumulative eligible trading volume thresholds during the event.
User Eligibility | Cumulative Eligible Trading Volume | Reward | Reward Quota
Inactive for 7–13 days | ≥ 10,000 USDT | 3 USDT | 100
Inactive for 14–29 days | ≥ 10,000 USDT | 4 USDT | 150
Inactive for 30 days or more | ≥ 20,000 USDT | 6 USDT | 100
User eligibility and inactivity periods will be determined based on the platform's data snapshot taken before the event starts. Each user may only receive the reward corresponding to their eligible tier. Rewards are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis.
## Event 2: Trading Milestone Rewards – Share 2,500 USDT
Restart your trading journey and unlock additional rewards. During the event, eligible returning users who trade any perpetual futures on Gate Perp DEX and reach the designated cumulative eligible trading volume thresholds can unlock corresponding milestone rewards, with up to 60 USDT in rewards per user.
Cumulative Eligible Trading Volume | Reward | Reward Quota
≥ 30,000 USDT | 5 USDT | 100
≥ 50,000 USDT | 10 USDT | 60
≥ 100,000 USDT | 20 USDT | 40
≥ 300,000 USDT | 60 USDT | 10
Rewards will be distributed based on the highest tier achieved, cannot be combined across tiers, and are available on a first-come, first-served basis.
## Event 3: Trading Consistency Challenge – Share 1,000 USDT
Get back into your trading rhythm and unlock more rewards. During the event, eligible returning users who trade perpetual futures for the designated number of days and meet the corresponding daily eligible trading volume requirements can earn additional trading rewards.
Trading Task | Daily Eligible Trading Volume | Reward | Reward Quota
Trade for a total of 3 days | ≥ 10,000 USDT | 5 USDT | 100
Trade for a total of 5 days | ≥ 20,000 USDT | 20 USDT | 25
Trading days do not need to be consecutive. Rewards will be distributed based on the highest tier achieved, cannot be combined across tiers, and are available on a first-come, first-served basis.
## Terms and Conditions
Users must register on the event page to participate. Trading volume and trading fees incurred before registration will not count toward the event.
This event is exclusively available to users who previously traded perpetual futures on Gate Perp DEX but have not conducted any perpetual futures trades on Gate Perp DEX for at least 7 consecutive days before the event starts. User eligibility will be determined based on the platform's data snapshot taken before the event starts.
Only eligible perpetual futures trading volume on Gate Perp DEX will count toward the event. API trades are excluded.
Daily trading volume and trading days will be calculated based on calendar days in UTC+8. Only eligible trading volume generated during the event period and after registration will be counted.
Users may earn rewards from multiple sub-events simultaneously. However, rewards from different tiers within the same sub-event cannot be combined. The total event rewards earned by each user cannot exceed 80% of the actual eligible net trading fees paid during the event.
Net trading fees exclude any amounts reduced or offset through other rebates, trading fee deductions, or promotional benefits.
The total prize pool is fixed, and rewards are limited. Rewards will be distributed in the order in which users meet the eligibility requirements, on a first-come, first-served basis, while supplies last.
All event rewards will be distributed in the form of Gate Web3 Futures Trial Funds and are expected to be distributed within 7–14 business days after the event ends.
Gate will review account activity, transactions, and fund transfers during the event. Violations include participating repeatedly through multiple accounts, identity impersonation or submission of false verification information, wash trading or matched trading, circular transfers of on-chain funds, coordinated reward abuse, repeated fund transfers, and any other activities that compromise the fairness of the event. Gate reserves the right to disqualify users found to have engaged in such violations from receiving rewards.
Institutional users, market makers, affiliate accounts, and sub-accounts are not eligible to participate in this event.
Gate Web3 reserves the right to modify and provide the final interpretation of this event to the extent permitted by applicable laws.

Venue: Gate
Headline: Gate Futures Points Airdrop #174: Claim 0.017 QQQG & 100 USDT

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
The 174th round of the Gate Futures Points Airdrop is now live. Two exclusive reward pools are open for redemption — first-come, first-served.
Pool 1: Redeem 0.017 QQQG with 15 Futures Points
Pool 2: Redeem 100 USDT with 20 Futures Points
Click to Join
## Reminder
To claim points airdrops, please update your App to version 8.13 or above. You can also participate directly on the Web version.
## Pool 1
Eligibility Requirement: Gate Futures Points balance ≥ 120–90 points (progressively decreasing)
Required Points: 15 Gate Futures Points
Reward: 0.017 QQQG, first-come, first-served
Airdrop Start Time: November 30, 2026, 10:00 (UTC)
Airdrop End Time: November 30, 2026, 15:59 (UTC)
Reward Distribution: Rewards will be credited to your Spot or Unified Account within about 1 hour after successful redemption.
## Pool 2
Eligibility: Gate Futures Points balance ≥ 40 points.
Required Points: 20 Gate Futures Points
Reward: 100 USDT position vouchers, first-come, first-served
Reward Distribution: Rewards will be issued within about 1 hour after successful redemption.
## Introduction to Gate Futures Points
- Points Definition: Gate Futures Points are an activity score that reflects how active a user is in futures trading on the Gate platform, calculated based on the user's asset holdings and trading activities. The point value is the cumulative total of daily points earned over the past 15 days.
- Core Function: Points directly determine your eligibility for airdrops, TGE subscriptions, and time-limited events. The higher your points, the more events and benefits you can access.
- Balance Calculation: A daily snapshot is taken of the USDT and BTC balances in your Futures Account (calculated in USD value). If your account is in Unified Account mode (Single-Currency Margin, Cross-Currency Margin, or Portfolio Margin), the snapshot will use the USDT and BTC balances in your Spot Account under the Unified Account to calculate asset value. Fixed points are awarded based on the corresponding tier.
## Notes
- All participants must complete identity verification before claiming rewards.
- The futures trading volume excludes copy trading and bot trading.
- Futures Points currently do not support USD1 trading, and the related trading volume will not be counted.
- The token rewards from the Futures Points Airdrop are distributed by the platform solely for reward purposes. The tokens themselves are independent of the platform. The relevant project may involve certain risks and price fluctuations; participants should exercise caution and fully understand the risks before taking part.
- Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the campaign. Prohibited conduct includes participating more than once using multiple accounts, using another person’s identity or submitting false verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, organizing schemes to claim rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the campaign. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
- In case of any discrepancies between the translated version and the English version, the English version shall prevail.
- Gate reserves the sole and exclusive right to interpret this event and may modify the terms or cancel the event at its discretion without prior notice.
- Users from the United Kingdom and other restricted regions have no access to all or parts of the services (including participating in this activity, game, or competition). For more information about restricted regions, please refer to the User Agreement. Please note that we do not intend to solicit or conduct marketing towards users in these areas.
